lessons.title: Persist categorical dictionaries across datasets
lessons.statement: When categorical integer codes are supplied to a trained tabular model, reuse a training-fitted category mapping for validation and inference. Verify the same category has the same code across datasets and define unknown-category behavior. Persistent dictionaries are proposed correction. Separate title and description tokenizers also share an embedding table in this script, requiring vocabulary identity auditing.
trigger_conditions: categorical integer codes are supplied to a trained tabular model
action_steps: Proposed: reuse a training-fitted category mapping for validation and inference.
verification_steps: Proposed: verify the same category has the same code across datasets and define unknown-category behavior.
limitations: Persistent dictionaries are proposed correction. Separate title and description tokenizers also share an embedding table in this script, requiring vocabulary identity auditing.
